description.en: Anchors a character's/object's drop shadow projection to a specific bone, with a given radius, instead of the default root-based projection. Commonly used on props like the ball so its shadow follows the correct bone as it moves.
Name of the bone to anchor the shadow to, e.g. "rot".
Whether bone-anchored shadow projection is enabled.
True once the call has taken effect; null if the call was invalid (e.g. too few arguments, or required engine/script state not ready).

example.code:
// Anchor the ball's shadow to its "rot" bone
CMND_SET_SHADOW_BONE(ahBall[i], "rot", true, 0.0099999998);
